entries.text: Hello, hello. I hope everyone’s ready to learn\nsome new things today![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_01

entries.text: I seem to remember teaching you all about the\nimportance of Eggs in our last class together.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_02

entries.text: Ah, on that note, is everyone using their\nPokédex?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_03

entries.text: It registers Pokémon born from Eggs as well as\nthose encountered via other methods, so don’t\r\nyou worry about that![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_04

entries.text: And, uh, hehe...just so you know, I’m the one who\ndeveloped the Pokédex app![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_05

entries.text: It was waaay before I started teaching here at the\nacademy, though.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_06

entries.text: Back then, I was a researcher.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_07

entries.text:
In fact, Director Clavell wasn’t working in
education at the time, either!\c
He was researching alongside me at the
same facility.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_08

entries.text: We got to research Pokémon together day in,\nday out... Those sure were fun times.\c\nI got yelled at all the time, though. Heh.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_09

entries.text: Wait a second, how did I get onto this?\nPretty sure I was talking about the Pokédex...[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_10

entries.text: Uh... Anyway! Today, I’d like to teach you about\ncatching Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_11

entries.text: As you all know, a great way to catch a Pokémon\nmore easily is to first lower its HP.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_12

entries.text: But there’s another way to up your chances of a\nsuccessful catch. Can you guess what it is?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_13

entries.text: Give the Pokémon a Berry
entries.label: class_a_03_select_01

entries.text: Inflict the Pokémon with a status condition
entries.label: class_a_03_select_02

entries.text: Prove you’re stronger than the Pokémon
entries.label: class_a_03_select_03

entries.text:
Huh? Hmmm... Maybe that’s a bit of advice from
another region?\c
The common understanding here in Paldea may
be a little different.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_answer_01

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wow! That’s right, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!\nGreat job![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_answer_02

entries.text:
That’s a rough-and-tumble way to look at things,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c
I guess it’s true that sending out a strong
Pokémon can turn a battle in your favor, though.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_answer_03

entries.text: The correct technique for making Pokémon easier\nto catch is to inflict them with a status condition.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_14

entries.text: Sleep is an especially effective status condition.\nIt makes Pokémon drastically easier to catch![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_15

entries.text: If you have a Pokémon that can use moves that\nput opponents to sleep, like Sleep Powder or\r\nHypnosis, filling up your Pokédex will be a cinch![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_16

entries.text: There are other ways to improve your catch rate\nas well, like using Poké Balls specifically designed\r\nto be effective against certain Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_17

entries.text: Eating food that gives you Catching Power works,\ntoo—or sneaking up on Pokémon from behind to\r\ncatch them by surprise when you start a battle![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_18

entries.text: If you’re having trouble, you may want to make\nthe rounds to the Gyms to get Gym Badges.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_19

entries.text: Earning Gym Badges will make it easier to catch\nPokémon of higher and higher levels![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_20

entries.text: Please do come show me your Pokédexes once\nthey start to fill up![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_21

entries.text: Another day, another enjoyable class. Oh yeah,\ndon’t forget—our next class will be a test![VAR 0x0114(002A)]
entries.label: class_a_03_ecology_22
